LLM is part of 5 of my public repositories, from 2025 to 2026.

What it was for: [AI engineering](@/projects/ai.md) (3) and [Tools](@/projects/tools.md) (2).

Most recently: [Majordomus](@/work/prismatic-majordomus.md): One policy for every AI coding tool, scoped tasks with a finish contract, a mesh for many sessions and machines, and an integration queue that lands only verified work. Local; it never invokes a model; [llm](@/work/llm.md): Local-first, provider-agnostic archive of AI conversations (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Codex) — immutable, content-addressed, searchable evidence layer built in Elixir/Ecto; [past](@/work/past.md).

1 of these projects runs as a live site.

How to read the evidence: every [repository](@/glossary/repository.md) below is measured from GitHub and GitLab (every 6 hours) and says how it uses LLM: as the main language, as a measured share of its code, in its declared stack or as a topic. The reference graph links LLM to the repositories and to the other languages and technologies they use together.
